newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates end sharply down, rev repos due.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates end sharply down, rev repos due.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates closed sharply lower on Friday as extra funds flowed into the market after one-month reverse repo deals struck just before Christmas expired, dealers said.
Overnight rates closed around 23.75 percent after gradually falling from an opening rate of 27.5/28 percent. On Thursday, overnight rates finished at 28 percent.
"Reverse repo deals made before Christmas have just expired," said Judit Kecskes of OTP Bank. "This had a substantial impact on the market."

The inflow of money eased the market's continuous tight forint supply, which stemmed from banks' increased lending activity and long-term government securities purchases on expectations of falling long-term interest rates.
